title: Welcome to Frame
paragraphs: Frame is a fictional cinema chain planning a comeback. Its cinemas are comfortable and its staff love films, but people increasingly leave a cinema visit off their list of evening plans.
Frame needs a reason for people to choose it beyond cheaper tickets or bigger screens. You’re joining the marketing team to help develop that reason.
There are three required tasks and two optional tasks. Submit everything as text. Each task has its own materials, and you can work on them independently.
